intro.text: Called the least of the Pantheon's islands, it lies at the end of the archipelago nearest the Eelakin homeisles.

description.text: The island is roughly three weeks from the homeisles by rowboat, and three islands close by are known as its cousins.
Because it is tamer than the rest, Sori serves as the training ground for apprentice trappers, who may not set foot on another island until their time there is done.
Sori has its share of strange plants and creatures, with deepwalkers in the surrounding waters, but it is far safer than its neighbours and offers a trapper little game worth catching.

Its name means "child", and the other islands are said to love it. Every trapper is welcome there and may leave it an offering without making his own island jealous. All trappers spend time there as apprentices, so it is the most visited island in the Pantheon.
